title: 第271章 看视频看多的蛊，真以为蜂医都卧虎藏龙？
slug: 三角洲招募威龙创电竞gti
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“不是哥，你在干什么啊？”

杨起家的声音里充斥着不敢置信的。

刚才还用二十四发子弹灭了一队满编的男人，现在转头就在那“哒，哒哒”地打暗号了？

这就是反差吗？

他一边在离心机里静步摸着，一边消化着刚才耳机里传来的那阵野牛暗号声。

要不是刚才亲眼看见蜂医用M14三发胸腹一发补头的操作，他都要以为对方是个真正的跑刀老鼠了。

......

离心机的航空箱没让他失望——一个万足金条，两个小金，稳的唐王爆率。

但杨起家此刻没什么心思去感受搜索的快乐了。

他把东西往保险里一塞，就找了个离心机底部的角落直接趴了下来。

原因很简单，场上目前除了总裁那边的脚步，其他方向一点信息都没有，这个时候贸然出去跑动，等于是白白暴露自己的位置。

不如趴着，等响枪再做判断。

趴下之后，杨起家掏出了手机，

画面跳出来的瞬间——他就看到了。

蜂医的第一人称视角里，总裁大门入口处最显眼的位置上，安静地摆着一个四格的暗红色物品。

天圆地方。

“我超威！”

杨起家一下子就明白了。

所谓的“我有自己的思路”，原来是认大哥流！

【哈哈，杨哥终于反应过来了！】

【你看你杨哥那表情，像不像被人抢了生意的同行？】

【同样是跑刀仔，你杨哥趴地上等信息，人家蜂医直接找猛攻队抱大腿！】

【这两个路线差距也太大了吧，一个是自力更生，一个是投靠大哥！】

“不是兄弟们，你们先别急着吹。”

杨起家放下手机，对着镜头竖起一根手指，语气里是那种“我懂但你们不懂”的自信。

“认大哥这个流派，我以前也不是没试过。”

“我给你们分析啊——”

“第一，现在航天的环境太差了。你知道有多少人是拿了你的上供转头就给你一枪的吗？满地都是刺客，认大哥被刺的案例你去论坛随便搜能搜出一千条！”

“第二，就算对方是好人，真放你走了。那这一队大哥他打得过全图吗？万一他们死了呢？”

“第三才是最致命的——他死了之后，下一队来的人看到地上一只没武装的绿裤子，你觉得他们会怎么做？”

“这时候蜂医手里可已经没有天圆地方了啊！对方杀他没有任何心理负担！”

杨起家越说越来劲，最后一拍桌子做了总结。

“所以我的结论是——还是自己高爆跑刀流更稳妥，胜率更高！起码命运是握在自己手里的！”

【有道理，确实现在航天被刺的太多了。】

【我上次就是拿了个小红上供结果被人收完直接崩了，气死。】

【但蜂医枪法这么好，就算被刺他不是能反杀吗？】

【那不一样，你被打暗号的人刺和被外面冲进来的人刺是两个概念。前者你毫无防备，后者你至少有反应时间。】

【说白了杨哥就是区嘛，趴在地上当区还要分析这么多，区就是区有什么好辩的？】

【当区就当区.ipg】

【串子能不能有点新花样？】

杨起家懒得理那些串子了，继续盯着手机屏幕上蜂医的视角。

画面里，总裁楼梯传来的脚步声越来越近。

三个人影先后出现在了楼梯口——走在最前面的是一个威龙，六级头六级甲满配，手里端着满改M14。

后面跟着一个露娜，背上背着AWM，手里拿着M7作为常规武器。

最后是一个女医蛊，看装备倒也不像是纯老板，应该是个正儿八经的支援位。

就光看阵容的话，这确实符合一个专业猛攻队应有的配置？

目光再度转回屏幕。

只见这一对猛攻哥在踏入总裁的第一时间就看到了地上那个天圆地方。

三个人的动作同时顿住了。

然后——为首的威龙转头看向了站在角落里，手里只拿着一把空野牛的蜂医。

沉默了大约两秒。

威龙的角色做了一个点头的动作，然后走向了天圆地方，将其拾起放入了背包。

杨起家看着这一幕，嘴角微微抽动了一下。

“行吧，第一关算是过了。”

“但我说白了，这才是开始。后面的事情谁说得准呢？”

"No, brother, what are you doing?"

Yang Qijia's voice was full of disbelief.

Just now, he used twenty-four rounds of bullets to kill a group of men, and now he turned around and started making signals with "ta, da da"?

Is this the contrast?

While he was stroking quietly in the centrifuge, he was digesting the burst of bison signals that came from the earphones just now.

If he hadn't just witnessed the bee doctor's operation of using three M14 rounds on the chest and abdomen to repair the head, he would have thought that the other party was a real knife-running rat.

...

The flight case of the centrifuge did not disappoint him - one gold bar, two small gold bars, a stable explosion rate for King Tang.

But Yang Qijia has no intention to feel the joy of searching at this moment.

He stuffed the things into the safe, found a corner at the bottom of the centrifuge and lay down directly.

The reason is very simple. Apart from the footsteps of the president, there is no information in other directions on the field. Going out to run rashly at this time is tantamount to exposing one's position in vain.

It's better to lie down and wait for the gun to sound before making a judgment.

After lying down, Yang Qijia took out his mobile phone.

The moment the picture popped up - he saw it.

From the bee doctor's first-person perspective, a dark red object with four grids was quietly placed in the most conspicuous position at the entrance to the president's door.

The sky is round and the place is round.

"I am super powerful!"

Yang Qijia understood immediately.

The so-called "I have my own ideas" turns out to be the elder brother style!

[Haha, Brother Yang finally reacted!】

[Look at the expression on your brother Yang’s face, does he look like a colleague whose business has been robbed?】

[It’s the same runner. You, Brother Yang, are lying on the ground waiting for information. The bee doctor goes directly to the onslaught team to hug him!】

[The gap between these two routes is too big, one is self-reliance, the other is to rely on big brother!】

"No, brothers, don't rush to brag."

Yang Qijia put down his mobile phone and raised a finger to the camera, with the confidence of "I understand but you don't" in his tone.

"It's not like I haven't tried this genre before."

"I'll analyze it for you—"

"First, the current aerospace environment is so bad. Do you know how many people take your confession and shoot you instead? There are assassins all over the place. If you search on the forum, you can find a thousand cases about the assassination of your elder brother!"

"Second, even if the opponent is a good person, he really lets you go. Then can the big brother of this team defeat the whole map? What if they die?"

"The third one is the most deadly - after he dies, the next group of people who come see an unarmed green pants on the ground, what do you think they will do?"

"At this time, the bee doctor has nothing left in his hands! The other party won't have any psychological burden to kill him!"

Yang Qijia became more and more enthusiastic as he talked, and finally summed up by slapping the table.

"So my conclusion is - it is safer to use your own high-explosive knife-running style and have a higher winning rate! At least your destiny is in your own hands!"

[It makes sense, it’s true that aerospace is being stabbed too much now.】

[Last time, I brought a small piece of red to offer as an offering, but someone took it away and I collapsed immediately. I was so angry.】

[But Doctor Bee’s marksmanship is so good, wouldn’t he be able to fight back even if he was stabbed?】

[That's different. Being stabbed by someone who gave a signal and being stabbed by someone rushing in from the outside are two different concepts.In the former case you are defenseless, in the latter case you at least have time to react.】

[To put it bluntly, Brother Yang is just a district. You have to analyze so much when you are lying on the ground as a district. What is there to argue about a district being a district?】

[Be a district, be a district.ipg]

[Can you have some new tricks on the skewers?】

Yang Qijia was too lazy to pay attention to those strings and continued to stare at the bee doctor's perspective on the screen of his mobile phone.

In the picture, the footsteps coming from the CEO's staircase are getting closer and closer.

Three figures appeared at the top of the stairs one after another - the one walking at the front was a Veyron, with a full level 6 head and level 6 armor, holding a fully modified M14 in his hand.

Followed by a Luna, with an AWM on her back and an M7 in her hand as a conventional weapon.

Finally, there is a female doctor Gu. Judging from the equipment, she does not look like a pure boss. She should be a serious support position.

Just looking at the lineup, does this really meet the configuration that a professional storm team should have?

His eyes turned back to the screen again.

I saw that the pair of fierce attack brothers saw the round sky on the ground as soon as they stepped into the CEO position.

The movements of the three people paused at the same time.

Then - Weilong, the leader, turned to look at the bee doctor standing in the corner with only an empty bison in his hand.

There was silence for about two seconds.

The Dragon character made a nodding gesture, then walked towards Tianyuandiandian, picked it up and put it into his backpack.

Looking at this scene, Yang Qijia's mouth twitched slightly.

"Okay, I've passed the first level."

"But let me put it bluntly, this is just the beginning. Who can say for sure what will happen next?"
